{
  "findings": [
    {
      "title": "Secondary endpoint without analysis",
      "quote": "Treatment response in non-injected target lesions based on RECIST v1.1 by BICR",
      "page": 33,
      "section": "2.2.2 Secondary Endpoints",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "This secondary endpoint is listed but no corresponding statistical analysis is described in the Statistical Methods section.",
      "fix": "Add a statistical analysis method for this endpoint in Section 9."
    },
    {
      "title": "Secondary endpoint without analysis",
      "quote": "Blood concentrations of CMP-001 or its metabolites",
      "page": 33,
      "section": "2.2.2 Secondary Endpoints",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The PK endpoint is listed but no analysis method is described in the Statistical Methods section.",
      "fix": "Add a PK analysis section describing the analysis of blood concentrations."
    },
    {
      "title": "Secondary endpoint without analysis",
      "quote": "Development of anti-Qb antibodies",
      "page": 33,
      "section": "2.2.2 Secondary Endpoints",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The immunogenicity endpoint is listed but no analysis method is described in the Statistical Methods section.",
      "fix": "Add an immunogenicity analysis section."
    },
    {
      "title": "Exploratory endpoint without analysis",
      "quote": "Response in injected and noninjected target lesions per intratumoral Response Evaluation Criteria in Solid Tumors (itRECIST, Appendix F, Goldmacher-2020) by Investigator assessment",
      "page": 34,
      "section": "2.2.3 Exploratory Endpoints",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "This exploratory endpoint is listed but no analysis method is described in the Statistical Methods section.",
      "fix": "Add an analysis method for itRECIST-based response."
    },
    {
      "title": "Missing estimand attributes for primary endpoint",
      "quote": "ORR, defined as the proportion of subjects with a confirmed objective response of CR or PR based on RECIST v1.1 as determined by BICR.",
      "page": 33,
      "section": "2.2.1 Primary Endpoint",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The primary endpoint lacks a full estimand specification: population (ITT is mentioned later but not here), intercurrent events (e.g., death, discontinuation) are not defined, and the summary measure is not explicitly stated as a proportion with handling of missing data.",
      "fix": "Provide a formal estimand with population, variable, intercurrent events, and summary measure."
    },
    {
      "title": "Sample size inconsistency",
      "quote": "This study will enroll approximately 100 subjects.",
      "page": 80,
      "section": "9.1 Sample Size Calculation",
      "category": "consistency",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The sample size is stated as 100 subjects, but the power calculation is based on 69 subjects, and the text says 'increased to 100 subjects' to adjust for discontinuation. However, the primary endpoint analysis may not account for the 15% discontinuation in the estimand, and the 100 subjects may not be evaluable for the primary endpoint.",
      "fix": "Clarify the analysis population for the primary endpoint and ensure the sample size accounts for missing data in the estimand."
    },
    {
      "title": "Missing multiplicity control",
      "quote": "A sample size of 69 subjects achieves at least 90% power to detect a difference of 13% using a 2-sided exact test with a significance level of 0.05",
      "page": 80,
      "section": "9.1 Sample Size Calculation",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The protocol does not describe any multiplicity adjustment for multiple secondary or exploratory endpoints, which may inflate the Type I error.",
      "fix": "Add a section on multiplicity control for secondary endpoints."
    },
    {
      "title": "Missing analysis for safety endpoint",
      "quote": "AEs, serious adverse events (SAEs), and AEs leading to discontinuation or death, and severity of AEs as assessed by the National Cancer Institute (NCI) Common Terminology Criteria for Adverse Events version 5.0 (CTCAE v5.0)",
      "page": 33,
      "section": "2.2.2 Secondary Endpoints",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "minor",
      "explanation": "The safety endpoint is listed but the statistical methods section only describes general safety analyses without specific analysis methods for this endpoint.",
      "fix": "Add specific statistical methods for safety endpoints, including AE incidence and severity."
    }
  ]
}
